Title: Seiko Presage Style 60's Automatic Sary 269
Description:
Seiko Presage Style 60's Automatic SARY269 — A Love Letter to Japanese Vintage Watchmaking

The Seiko Presage Style 60's Automatic SARY269 is a stunning tribute to the golden era of Japanese horology. Featuring a rich champagne dial inspired by the Taisho art deco period, this automatic timepiece captures vintage elegance with modern precision. Powered by Seiko's in-house Caliber 4R35 movement with 41-hour power reserve, the SARY269 is water-resistant to 50 meters and fitted with a hardlex mineral crystal. The warm amber-toned dial, paired with a hand-stitched brown leather strap, makes it the perfect statement piece for any occasion.

  • Movement: Seiko Caliber 4R35 — Automatic, self-winding
  • Power Reserve: 41 hours
  • Crystal: Hardlex mineral
  • Water Resistance: 50m (5 bar)
  • Case Material: Stainless steel
  • Case Diameter: 40.5mm
  • Strap: Genuine leather, brown

Colección Presage — Where the past inspires the present.

Title: Seiko 5 Oyster Gray Sunburst
Description:
Seiko 5 Oyster — The Iconic Automatic Built to Last a Lifetime

The Seiko 5 Oyster is the definitive everyday automatic watch — built for the wrist that never stops moving. Featuring Seiko's legendary Caliber 7S26 self-winding movement with 40-hour power reserve, the watch comes in five sophisticated colorways — Black, Blue, Gray, Silver, and Gold — to match every style and occasion. The day-date window at 3 o'clock adds everyday practicality, while the stainless steel case and bracelet ensure long-lasting durability. Zero batteries. Pure reliability.

  • Movement: Seiko Caliber 7S26 — Automatic, self-winding
  • Power Reserve: 40 hours
  • Crystal: Hardlex mineral
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Case Material: Stainless steel, 37mm
  • Bracelet: Stainless steel with fold-over clasp
  • Day and date display at 3 o'clock
  • Made in Japan

Available in 5 colorways — select yours above.

No battery. No compromise. Just time, perfectly kept.

Title: Seiko Prospex Land Alpinist
Description:
Seiko Prospex Land Alpinist — Built for the Summit, Worn for Life

The Seiko Prospex Land Alpinist is engineered for those who conquer mountains. Featuring a distinctive green textured dial with Arabic numeral indexes and a sapphire crystal, this automatic timepiece is powered by Seiko's Caliber 6R35 with an impressive 70-hour power reserve. Water-resistant to 200 meters, encased in stainless steel, and finished with a rich brown leather strap, the Land Alpinist perfectly combines field watch practicality with refined Japanese craftsmanship.

  • Movement: Seiko Caliber 6R35 — Automatic, self-winding
  • Power Reserve: 70 hours
  • Crystal: Sapphire with anti-reflective coating
  • Water Resistance: 200m (20 bar)
  • Case Material: Stainless steel
  • Strap: Brown genuine leather
  • Anti-magnetic protection

For those who don't stop at the horizon.

Title: Seiko Presage Cocktail Time
Description:
Seiko Presage Cocktail Time — When Time Becomes Art

The Seiko Presage Cocktail Time is a liquid inspiration in watch form — a collection where each timepiece takes its identity from the world's most iconic cocktails. Available in Blue (Blue Moon), Brown (Amber), and Green (Grasshopper), each sunburst dial is a radiant masterpiece of color and light. Powered by the Caliber 4R35 automatic movement with 41-hour power reserve, this watch brings artistry and precision together in perfect harmony. Water-resistant to 50 meters, fitted with a hardlex crystal and a paired leather strap.

  • Movement: Seiko Caliber 4R35 — Automatic, self-winding
  • Power Reserve: 41 hours
  • Crystal: Hardlex mineral
  • Water Resistance: 50m (5 bar)
  • Case Diameter: 40.5mm — Stainless steel
  • Sunray dial finish — Available in Blue, Brown, Green
  • Genuine leather strap

Choose your cocktail. Wear your story.

Title: Seiko Prospex 1968 Heritage Diver's
Description:
Seiko Prospex 1968 Heritage Diver's — A Legend Reborn from the Deep

The Seiko Prospex 1968 Heritage Diver's is a faithful reinterpretation of Seiko's legendary 1968 Professional Diver's — the watch that pioneered Japanese deep-sea exploration. Featuring the iconic asymmetric case with its crown-protecting shoulder, this masterpiece is powered by the high-beat Caliber 8L35 automatic movement running at 28,800 vph with 50-hour power reserve. Water-resistant to 300 meters, with a sapphire crystal and unidirectional rotating bezel, it unites heritage aesthetics with professional diving performance.

  • Movement: Seiko Caliber 8L35 — Automatic, 28,800 vph
  • Power Reserve: 50 hours
  • Crystal: Sapphire with anti-reflective coating
  • Water Resistance: 300m (30 bar)
  • Unidirectional rotating diver's bezel
  • Case: Asymmetric stainless steel
  • Stainless steel bracelet with diver's extension

Born in 1968. Reborn for eternity.

Title: Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch Snoopy
Description:
Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch Snoopy Edition — A Tribute to NASA's Silver Spur Award

The Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch Snoopy Edition celebrates NASA's Silver Spur Award, honoring Omega's critical contribution to the Apollo 13 rescue mission. Presented with Snoopy himself animated in the seconds subdial, this iconic chronograph features a striking white and blue color scheme — a nod to the mission's splashdown beneath a night sky. Powered by the Master Chronometer Caliber 3861, COSC-certified and anti-magnetic to 15,000 gauss. A collector's masterpiece where space history and horological excellence meet.

  • Movement: Omega Caliber 3861 — Co-Axial Master Chronometer
  • COSC Chronometer certified
  • Anti-magnetic to 15,000 gauss (METAS certified)
  • Power Reserve: 50 hours
  • Crystal: Sapphire, scratch-resistant
  • Water Resistance: 50m (5 bar)
  • Chronograph with 12-hour counter and tachymeter scale
  • Hesalite crystal caseback with Snoopy animation

The watch that helped bring Apollo 13 home.

Title: Omega Speedmaster Professional
Description:
Omega Speedmaster Professional Moonwatch — The Watch That Went to the Moon

The Omega Speedmaster Professional is the most iconic timepiece in history — the only watch certified by NASA for all manned space missions, worn by astronauts from Mercury to the International Space Station. Featuring the hand-wound Caliber 3861 Master Chronometer movement, COSC-certified with 60-hour power reserve and anti-magnetic protection to 15,000 gauss. The tachymeter bezel, iconic black dial, and stainless steel bracelet make this the ultimate professional tool watch for those who aim for the stars.

  • Movement: Omega Caliber 3861 — Hand-wound Master Chronometer
  • COSC & METAS certified
  • Anti-magnetic to 15,000 gauss
  • Power Reserve: 60 hours
  • Crystal: Hesalite (front) / Sapphire (caseback)
  • Water Resistance: 50m (5 bar)
  • Tachymeter scale on bezel
  • Stainless steel bracelet

Worn on the moon. Proven in space. Perfected for Earth.

Title: Omega De Ville Co-Axial Chronometer
Description:
Omega De Ville Co-Axial Chronometer — The Pinnacle of Swiss Dress Watchmaking

The Omega De Ville Co-Axial Chronometer represents the apex of Swiss watchmaking refinement. With its slim, elegant profile and impeccably finished case, the De Ville embodies timeless dress watch sophistication. Powered by Omega's Co-Axial escapement — a revolutionary technology that reduces friction and dramatically extends service intervals — and METAS-certified as a Master Chronometer. This is the watch for those who understand that true luxury is invisible to the untrained eye.

  • Movement: Omega Co-Axial Master Chronometer
  • METAS Master Chronometer certified
  • Anti-magnetic to 15,000 gauss
  • Co-Axial escapement for superior long-term accuracy
  • Crystal: Sapphire, scratch-resistant, anti-reflective
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Case: Polished stainless steel
  • Alligator leather strap

Where precision becomes poetry.

Title: Omega Seamaster Diver 300
Description:
Omega Seamaster Diver 300m — The Legend. The Bond Watch. The Benchmark.

The Omega Seamaster Diver 300m is the world's most recognizable professional dive watch — made legendary by James Bond and trusted by real-world diving professionals for over 70 years. Available in Blue, Black, and White, each model features a hypnotic wave-patterned dial and ceramic bezel, powered by the Co-Axial Master Chronometer Caliber 8800 with METAS certification and anti-magnetic protection to 15,000 gauss. Water-resistant to 300 meters. The ultimate fusion of performance and iconic design.

  • Movement: Omega Caliber 8800 — Co-Axial Master Chronometer
  • METAS certified — Anti-magnetic to 15,000 gauss
  • Power Reserve: 55 hours
  • Crystal: Sapphire, double anti-reflective coating
  • Water Resistance: 300m (30 bar)
  • Unidirectional rotating ceramic bezel
  • Wave-patterned dial — Available in Blue, Black, White
  • Stainless steel bracelet or rubber strap

Bond's choice. The diver's standard. Your legend.

Title: Omega Constellation Co-Axial Mater Chronometer
Description:
Omega Constellation Co-Axial Master Chronometer — A Symbol of Timeless Prestige

The Omega Constellation has been synonymous with precision and prestige since 1952. Today's Constellation carries the iconic clawed case design and is powered by the Master Chronometer caliber — the world's most rigorously tested movement certification. Available in Blue, with an elegant polished stainless steel case and integrated bracelet, the Constellation represents the perfect intersection of luxury, precision, and enduring elegance for the modern connoisseur.

  • Movement: Omega Co-Axial Master Chronometer
  • METAS Master Chronometer certified
  • Anti-magnetic to 15,000 gauss
  • Power Reserve: 60 hours
  • Crystal: Sapphire, scratch-resistant
  • Water Resistance: 100m (10 bar)
  • Iconic claw-case architecture
  • Integrated stainless steel bracelet

Since 1952, the standard of excellence.

Title: Casio MTP-V300D-1A Executive
Description:
Casio MTP-V300D-1A Executive — Classic Precision for Every Occasion

The Casio MTP-V300D-1A Executive blends clean analog design with rock-solid everyday reliability. Featuring a crisp silver dial with day-date display, this quartz timepiece is built from stainless steel and matched with a polished stainless steel bracelet. Japanese quartz movement ensures accurate timekeeping with minimal maintenance. Water-resistant to 50 meters, the MTP-V300D is the versatile professional watch that works as hard as you do — from the boardroom to the weekend.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Mineral glass
  • Water Resistance: 50m (5 bar)
  • Case Material: Stainless steel
  • Day-date display
  • Stainless steel bracelet

Timeless. Reliable. Effortlessly professional.

Title: Casio Vintage
Description:
Casio Vintage — The Icon of Retro Digital Style

The Casio Vintage collection is a love letter to the golden era of digital watches. These iconic square-cased timepieces have graced the wrists of pop icons, designers, and visionaries for over four decades. Available in Green, White, Black, and Blue, each model features a vintage-inspired case, EL backlight, multi-function display, and Casio's legendary battery life. Retro aesthetics, modern reliability — the ultimate streetwear accessory that never goes out of style.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz digital
  • EL backlight for easy night reading
  • Multi-function display: time, date, alarm, stopwatch
  • Battery life: approximately 7 years
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Resin case and strap
  • Available in Green, White, Black, Blue

Retro soul. Modern spirit. Casio forever.

Title: Casio Gold
Description:
Casio Gold — Timeless Elegance, Everyday Luxury

The Casio Gold series brings warm, golden luxury to everyday timekeeping. These refined analog timepieces feature gold-tone stainless steel cases and bracelets with elegant proportions, powered by Casio's precise Japanese quartz movement. The classic dial design and day-date complication make this a versatile companion for formal occasions and daily wear alike. Durable, low-maintenance, and beautifully finished — timeless style at an accessible price.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Mineral glass
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Case & Bracelet: Gold-tone stainless steel
  • Day-date display

Gold without compromise. Elegance without limits.

Title: Casio General
Description:
Casio General — No-Nonsense, Reliable, Ready for Anything

The Casio General defines straightforward, dependable timekeeping. Built on Casio's decades of expertise in precision watches, this versatile timepiece delivers clean analog style in Blue with a stainless steel case and bracelet. Powered by accurate Japanese quartz movement, water-resistant, and designed for long-lasting performance — the ideal everyday watch for anyone who values function and simplicity in equal measure.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Mineral glass
  • Water Resistance: 50m (5 bar)
  • Case Material: Stainless steel
  • Stainless steel bracelet

Simple. Precise. Casio dependable.

Title: Casio Moonphase
Description:
Casio Moonphase — Astronomical Elegance on Your Wrist

The Casio Moonphase brings the poetry of the lunar cycle to everyday wear. Featuring a sophisticated moonphase complication alongside day-date functionality, this elegant timepiece adds astronomical beauty to your wrist. Available in Black and White, with refined analog dials and stainless steel cases, the Casio Moonphase delivers impressive complication watchmaking at an unbeatable price. Powered by accurate Japanese quartz movement, it elevates any look from casual to formal.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz with moonphase complication
  • Crystal: Mineral glass
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Moonphase display
  • Day-date display
  • Stainless steel case and bracelet
  • Available in Black and White

Track the moon. Own the night.

Title: Poedagar 613
Description:
Poedagar 613 — Bold Sports Chronograph for the Modern Man

The Poedagar 613 commands attention the moment it hits your wrist. This bold sports chronograph features a large 44mm stainless steel case with luminous hands, multi-subdial design, and a striking dial available in Blue, White, Black, and Green. Scratch-resistant sapphire glass, waterproof stainless steel construction, and Japanese quartz movement make the Poedagar 613 a stunning statement piece built to last. Premium stainless steel mesh or link bracelet included.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz chronograph
  • Crystal: Sapphire glass, scratch-resistant
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Case Diameter: 44mm, stainless steel
  • Luminous hands and markers
  • Stainless steel bracelet
  • Available in Blue, White, Black, Green

Make your mark. Wear Poedagar 613.

Title: Poedagar Horizont 810
Description:
Poedagar Horizont 810 — Architectural Elegance Meets Sport Precision

The Poedagar Horizont 810 brings bold architectural design to the world of sports watches. Its distinctive geometric case shape and sunray-brushed dial create a strong visual presence on the wrist. Scratch-resistant sapphire glass protects the dial, while the waterproof stainless steel construction handles everyday demands with ease. Powered by precise Japanese quartz movement and finished with a premium stainless steel bracelet — whether at the office or the weekend, the Horizont 810 commands respect.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Sapphire glass, scratch-resistant
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Case: Geometric stainless steel
  • Sunray-brushed dial
  • Premium stainless steel bracelet

Where architecture meets precision.

Title: Poedagar 930
Description:
Poedagar 930 — Multi-Function Sports Watch for the Active Lifestyle

The Poedagar 930 is engineered for the man who never slows down. Available in Green, Black, and Blue, this rugged sports timepiece features a bold 44mm stainless steel case with luminous markers, day-date complications, and chronograph functions. Built waterproof with sapphire crystal and driven by reliable Japanese quartz movement, the 930 is the ideal companion for sport, travel, and adventure. Premium stainless steel bracelet with butterfly deployment clasp.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz multi-function
  • Crystal: Sapphire glass
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Case Diameter: 44mm, stainless steel
  • Luminous hands and markers
  • Day-date display
  • Available in Green, Black, Blue

Adventure-ready. Always.

Title: Poedagar 896
Description:
Poedagar 896 — Minimalist Masculinity, Maximum Impact

The Poedagar 896 is where minimalism meets masculine elegance. Featuring a clean, refined dial with slim hour markers and sleek geometric case design, the 896 answers the call for understated sophistication. Powered by Japanese quartz movement, water-resistant to 30 meters, with anti-scratch sapphire crystal and premium stainless steel finishing throughout. A versatile timepiece that transitions effortlessly from boardroom meetings to weekend escapes.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Sapphire glass, scratch-resistant
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Case: Stainless steel
  • Clean minimalist dial design
  • Premium stainless steel bracelet

Less is more. The Poedagar 896.

Title: Poedagar Silver Star
Description:
Poedagar Silver Star — Polish, Power, and Precision

The Poedagar Silver Star shines with polished precision. Available in White, Black, and Blue, this elegant timepiece features a striking silver-tone stainless steel case with diamond-cut bezel accents and a luminous dial that stands out in any light. Japanese quartz movement ensures reliable accuracy, while waterproof construction and sapphire crystal protect against daily wear. The Silver Star is for those who demand both style and substance from their everyday watch.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Sapphire glass
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Case: Polished stainless steel with diamond-cut bezel
  • Luminous dial
  • Available in White, Black, Blue

Shine on. The Poedagar Silver Star.

Title: Curren 8488
Description:
Curren 8488 — Bold Chronograph Style That Turns Heads

The Curren 8488 makes an immediate impression with its bold, fashion-forward design. Available in Black Gold, White Gold, and All Black, this 44mm chronograph-style timepiece features eye-catching multi-subdial aesthetics, tachymeter scale, luminous hands, and a premium stainless steel bracelet. Powered by reliable Japanese quartz movement, the 8488 delivers maximum visual impact at an unbeatable price. Perfect for those who want to make a statement without compromise.

  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)

  • Tachymeter scale, luminous hands
  • Stainless steel bracelet

Be bold. Wear the 8488.

Title: Curren 8439
Description:
Curren 8439 — Effortless Style for Every Occasion

The Curren 8439 redefines accessible elegance with its slim profile and refined analog design. Available in Black, Blue, and White, this dress-sport hybrid features a polished stainless steel case and bracelet with subtle brushed accents and a clean, legible dial. Accurate Japanese quartz movement, water-resistant construction, and premium finishing make the 8439 the watch you reach for when you need to look sharp — from casual Fridays to formal events.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Mineral glass
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Stainless steel case and bracelet
  • Clean, legible analog dial

From office to evening. The Curren 8439.

Title: Curren Arcturus
Description:
Curren Arcturus — Inspired by the Brightest Star in the Northern Sky

The Curren Arcturus — named after one of the brightest stars in the night sky — is a luminous celebration of design and contrast. Available in Silver Blue and Black Yellow, this distinctive chronograph-style watch features bold color blocking, luminous markers, and a striking multi-layered dial. Stainless steel case and bracelet with Japanese quartz movement make the Arcturus as reliable as it is eye-catching — a timepiece that stands apart in any crowd.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Mineral glass
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Bold color contrast design
  • Luminous markers and hands
  • Stainless steel case and bracelet
  • Available in Silver Blue, Black Yellow

As bright as a star. The Curren Arcturus.

Title: Curren 8446
Description:
Curren 8446 — Contemporary Design, Timeless Appeal

The Curren 8446 strikes the perfect balance between contemporary style and classic reliability. Available in Black and Silver, this sport-elegance hybrid features a clean dial with day-date window, polished stainless steel case, and a matching bracelet with butterfly deployment clasp. Powered by Japanese quartz movement and built with water resistance for daily use, the 8446 is the versatile everyday timepiece for the modern man who wants style and function in one watch.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Mineral glass
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Day-date display
  • Butterfly deployment clasp
  • Stainless steel case and bracelet
  • Available in Black, Silver

Style that works as hard as you do.

Title: Curren Dominus
Description:
Curren Dominus — The Watch That Commands the Room

The Curren Dominus lives up to its name — this is a commanding, authoritative timepiece that leads, not follows. Available in Silver and Black, the Dominus features a large-format case with bold dial design, multiple time functions, luminous applied markers, and a premium stainless steel case and bracelet. Japanese quartz movement and water-resistant construction complete a package designed for those who demand presence and performance from their wrist.

  • Movement: Japanese quartz
  • Crystal: Mineral glass
  • Water Resistance: 30m (3 bar)
  • Large format dial with bold design
  • Luminous applied markers
  • Premium stainless steel case and bracelet
  • Available in Silver, Black

Lead. Don't follow. Wear the Dominus.
